Name: Prevent Lamp Deactivation
Description: Enabling this will prevent Oedon Chappel and Grand Cathedral lamps from being inaccessible during certain parts of Eileen's quest. Hypogean Gaol lamp will be accessible and function fully after Rom.

Name: Auto Refill Bullets And Vials
Description: A sort of "estus-like" system for bullets and blood vials. They will refill to your character's max capacity when warping or resting. No more farming!

Name: Auto-Refill: Lamp Kindling
Description: In case the regular restock feels too cheaty. Works very similarly to bonfire kindling in Dark Souls. Instead of always fully restocking vials and bullets, the amount will be determined by the lamp's kindling level. A new option Offer Insight is added to lamps, where one insight will be consumed to kindle the lamp. Unkindled will restore up to 5 of each, kindled once restores 10, kindled twice restores 15, and kindled three times fully restocks. In order to kindle a lamp more than once, the Rite of Kindling will have to be acquired by defeating the Shadow of Yharnam.

Name: Lamp Menu
Description: Completely enable or disable the lamp menu. Disabled means lamps will function exactly as they do without any mods.

Name: Lamp Menu: Resting (Auto Reawaken)
Description: Enable "resting" at lamps. Enemies will de-agro and you will be forced to reawaken once the lamp menu is closed, meaning enemies will be respawned but you'll be fully healed and restocked.

Name: Lamp Menu: Auto Resting
Description: Enabling this will make you rest immediately when interacting with a lamp. When this feature is disabled, the lamp menu will have a rest option. All menu features will be hidden behind this rest option, except for warping and boss rematches.

Name: Lamp Menu: Warp
Description: This gives the option to warp from any lamp to any other unlocked lamp.

Name: Lamp Menu: Level Up
Description: Channel blood echoes at any lamp.

Name: Lamp Menu: Workshop
Description: Upgrade, repair, and equip blood gems on your weapons at lamps.

Name: Lamp Menu: Memory Alter
Description: Change equiped runes at lamps.

Name: Lamp Menu: Storage
Description: Access storage from lamps.

Name: Lamp Menu: Messengers
Description: Access messenger shops from lamps, including the stocked shop.

Name: Lamp Menu: Change Appearance
Description: Change your character's appearance at lamps. Requires reloading (warping anywhere) for all changes to take affect.

Name: Lamp Menu: Boss Rematches
Description: Gives the option to refight a boss at their respective lamp.

Name: Quick Warp to Bosses
Description: This, like the Stakes of Marika in Elden Ring, seeks to eliminate long boss runbacks. After encountering a boss for the first time and until that boss is defeated, nearby lamps will show an option in the warp menu to quickly warp back to the boss arena.

Name: Prompt Quick Warp to Bosses
Description: Automatically show the "Quick Warp to Bosses" menu after dying to a boss and respawning.

Name: Spawn Iosefka Clinic Lamp at Start
Description: At the beginning of the game, immediately spawn the lamp down the stairs from where you wake up.

Name: Broken Lamp
Description: Enable the broken lamp in the Hunter's Dream. The broken lamp grants the ability to rematch any boss (excluding chalice dungeon bosses) directly from the Hunter's Dream.

Name: Broken Lamp: Victory Respawn Location
Description: For rematches that are triggered from the broken lamp. Respawn in the Hunter's Dream or at the boss lamp on victory and hunter's mark. Quitting out will always spawn you at the boss lamp.

Name: Broken Lamp: Death Respawn Location
Description: For rematches that are triggered from the broken lamp. Respawn in the Hunter's Dream or at the boss lamp on death. Note that on death, you will drop your echoes in the boss arena. Quitting out will always spawn you at the boss lamp.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Warp
Description: Warp directly to any unlocked lamp from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Level Up
Description: Level up from anywhere.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Workshop
Description: Access the workshop to upgrade weapons from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Memory Alter
Description: Access the memory alter to swap equipped runes from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Storage
Description: Access the storage box from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Messengers
Description: Access the messenger shops from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Change Appearance
Description: Change character's appearance from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Enhanced Features
Description: Access the "Enhanced Features" settings menu from any location.

Name: Prime Hunter's Mark: Double Tap Action
Description: Change what happens when you double-tap use this item.

Name: Grand-Resonance Bell: Double Tap Action
Description: Change what happens when you double-tap use this item.

Name: Always Show Summon Signs
Description: Make NPC summon signs always available for use. Subject to some standard restrictions, such as only 2 summons being allowed at a time.

Name: Boss Rematch Scaling
Description: If enabled, boss rematches will scale to the next difficulty level. E.g., if you're on you're first play through, boss rematches will scale to new game plus difficulty.

Name: Advance the Cycle
Description:
Warning: This cannot be disabled in game. While this is enabled, all new characters will have this feature enabled.

Set the starting new game cycle to increase difficulty. NG is the game's default and NG+6 is the highest difficulty.

Name: Dark Fog
Description: This will cloud the world in a dark fog, making it difficult to see for increased difficulty. Random Spawn will give a 1 in 3 chance of being foggy when spawning and the fog will stay active until the next load. Random Time will activate and deactivate the fog dynamically as you play. Requires sfx folder.

Name: Hunter's Dream: Fire
Description: Edit settings for Hunter's Dream Workshop appearing on fire.

Name: Hunter's Dream: Music
Description: Edit settings for Hunter's Dream music. Also applies to lamps if the lamp music setting is enabled.

Name: Prevent Auto NG+
Description: Prevent the game from automatically continuing to new game+ when defeating the last boss. The doll will have a new menu option to trigger new game+ when you want.

Name: Stocked Shop
Description: Enable the special cheat shop that has all weapons, armors, hunter's tools, runes, chalices, chalice materials, and upgrade materials available for free.

Name: Temporary Stocked Shop
Description: The messenger that normally gives the starting trick weapon on the staircase in the Hunter's Dream will display the stocked shop menu instead of the normal weapon options. This messenger will only be available on the first visit to the Hunter's Dream. Useful if you only want the shop available for building your character at the start.

Name: Shops Plus
Description: Enable this to allow purchase of coldblood in the messenger shop as a way to bank blood echoes. Also displays new variants of items in regular echoe and insight shops.

Name: Rematch Death Action
Description: Can restart a boss rematch automatically if you die.

Name: Rematch Cutscenes
Description: Play boss intro cutscenes during rematches.

Name: Auto Unlock Chalice Doors
Description:
Unlock all lever doors in chalice dungeons. For those who just want to rush bosses.

Not recommended for new players.

Name: Random Moon Cycles
Description: Randomize the moon cycle when loading into a map. This is visual only, and currently only affects the following areas: Central Yharnam, Cathedral Ward, Hemwick Charnel Lane, Yahar'gul, the Hunter's Nightmare, Abandoned Old Workshop, and the Hunter's Dream.

Name: Require Gesture for Mod Menu
Description: If enabled, you will have to bow to the doll each time you return to the Hunter's Dream in order for the mod menu to appear. Disabling this will keep the option in the menu permanently.

Name: Great Bridge Door
Description: New interaction for the door that connects the Great Bridge to the Cathedral Ward. Knock on it to warp to the other side.

Name: Unlock All Lamps
Description:
Warning: This cannot be disabled in game. While this is enabled, all new characters will have this feature enabled.

All lamps will become warpable. You may still have to light the lamps when encountering them. Warping to a boss lamp before defeating the boss may cause issues.

Name: Activate All Shortcuts
Description:
Warning: This cannot be disabled in game. While this is enabled, all new characters will have this feature enabled.

Open almost all locked doors and activate all elevators.

Name: Infinite Durability
Description: Always keeps your equipment repaired.

Name: Ghost Shop
Description:
Activate a new ghost merchant in the Hunter's Dream that sells ghost variants of armors and weapons, as well as visual effects for your Hunter in exchange for ghost tokens.

Ghost tokens are hidden throughout the game in the form of a new collectible item.

Ghost Hunter's may be watching from hidden locations. They are invisible from a distance, except for a red aura around them, and will drop a ghost token when killed.

Boss rematches also have a chance to drop tokens, depending on the difficulty of the rematch.
